name: The Summer Company
desc:
The Summer Company is a faction that operates in their headquarters, [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle), in [The Aratel Sea](location:the_aratel_sea). They are the premier manufacturers of firearms and ammunition in Lumen.

The company was founded prior to 1062 CE when the [son of a young village blacksmith](entity:gunsmith_rosen) who journeyed into the sea, returning with the innovations of guns and forever changing the art of combat.

Alongside [The Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union) and the [Divers](faction:the_divers), the Summer Company is employed by [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority). Notably, there was an incident surrounding the Authority when [Gunsmith Hierka](entity:gunsmith_hierka) of the [Bureau of Research](faction:bureau_of_research) was sent to steal the company's secrets, resulting in the creation of the Rifle Spear.

They frequently come to blows with [Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union), who steal their gunpowder and explosives for themselves, In retaliation, they snuck into [Miner's Landing](location:miners_landing) and accidentally activated unfinished prototypes of the Union's security devices, the Mechalodaunts, making the cyborgs aggressively attack friend and foe alike.
additional_info:
-   Despite being on very good terms with the Central Authority, the Authority Ensign Origin spawns with Neutral reputation with the Company. In contrast the Divers and, ironically, the Union spawn with Friend reputation.
-   There is presumably an **Ironsinger** among their ranks because the Summer Dragoon armor has Ironsing resistances and is implied to be Mag due to how he can make bullet casings with ore.
-   All the named members of Summer Company are named after parts of guns.
    -   [Scope](entity:scope) is named after the scope.
    -   [Trig](entity:trig) is named after the trigger.
    -   [Mag](entity:mag) is named after the magazine.
